## The guard

Both priced: 33,412; more than 0.5 apart: 95; with 3 or more other books: 95, keeping Pinnacle on 12 and BetOnline on 83.

**Who was right when Pinnacle and BetOnline were more than 0.5 apart** (95 matches; the other books sided with Pinnacle on 12). Log loss, mLL, + = the first named worse: Pinnacle − BetOnline -53 [-92, -13]; Pinnacle − the other books' median -34 [-66, -2]; BetOnline − the other books' median +19 [-2, +40]. Favourite won: Pinnacle's 97%, BetOnline's 94%.

**Pinnacle's two recordings reconciled:** both on 32,213 matches, more than 0.1 apart with other books on 930, OddsTrader's taken on 294 (2018: 8, 2019: 21, 2020: 25, 2021: 105, 2022: 23, 2023: 23, 2024: 23, 2025: 66); OddsTrader's only on 665.
